profile.headline: Fullstack Software & AI Engineer
profile.summary:
I am proficient in a wide range of languages and fields, from full-stack web application development with Python and JavaScript to embedded systems with C. I pride myself on being able to learn skills quickly.

I learned to code when I was 10 and I am always looking for opportunities to challenge myself, learn new technologies, and make a meaningful contribution. Whether working on a team or independently, I am able to take on complex novel projects and deliver high-quality results.

positions.title: Cyber Security Operations Intern
positions.locationName: Downers Grove, Illinois, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
Built a proof‑of‑value internal secrets discovery tool in Kotlin that scans Confluence/Jira/SharePoint using regex + entropy and a custom neural network to suppress false positives—exposing credentials at scale that cannot be found manually and informing a buy‑vs‑build decision on enterprise solutions.

Investigated and contained ~10 user compromises (phishing/malware) using Microsoft Defender XDR, Microsoft Sentinel (KQL), Google Chronicle/SecOps, and CrowdStrike; authored a single KQL query that traced phishing link clicks end‑to‑end, accelerating triage and reducing handoffs.

Supported vulnerability management and asset hygiene across 10,000+ endpoints and a hybrid server footprint (on‑prem, AWS, Azure) using Tenable, Axonius, and Flexera; triaged findings and drove remediation via ServiceNow workflows.

Strengthened identity and password hygiene with a Microsoft account password audit; authored clear runbooks, playbooks, and implementation guides for the security toolset.
positions.insights: Skills: Kotlin · Java · Python (Programming Language) · Crowdstrike Falcon · Tenable.io · Axonius · Microsoft Defender · Microsoft Entra ID

projects.title: Makerspace OS
projects.description: Designed and developed a full-stack application to simplify and automate the 3D printing workflow for users and staff. Validates & extracts information from a file and uses it to improve the UX when entering information. This information is used to automatically manage multiple brands and types of 3D printers to improve operations efficiency. Uses Docker to connect multiple frontends and backends of various languages and databases. Currently working on re-architecting the main backend in Rust to improve simplicity, security, and speed.

projects.title: UW Makerspace Design Challenge
projects.description: As part of a team of students interested in engineering, I programmed the prototypes and final design of a 3D-printed automated feeder for the lemur habitat at the local zoo. I worked with a ESP32 microcontroller and taught myself C++ to create an IoT program to automatically manage the feeding schedule.
